description: Today, I want to give an enormous shout-out and thank you to these 8 businesses and organizations who have opened or reopened their doors in Malden during these past few months. Running a businesses or organization is never easy, but these folks have pushed through unprecedented circumstances to serve our community, and bring us some of the light we need during these tough times.While I’m sad I wasn’t able to get an invitation to these ribbon cuttings over the past few months because of COVID re
